title: Tazell NDE 1070
content: I was in a warm and very comfortable place. I was not on this earth, but in dark space. I had the feeling that I had been here before, like I was home at last. I had no eyes that I could tell but I could see in every direction at the same time. Not only could I see but also I knew what was around me - I had many more senses than smell, sight, hearing, speech, etc., - and an ocean of knowledge. I had no knowledge of earth or my wife or son and saw no people.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Heart attack heart attack was in ER and was given TPA to dissolve a clot when may heart stopped beating but fluttered no blood to the brain for 3 and one half minutes
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Darkness | Light | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Vision of the future
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I had no body, did not need a body.
elements.At what time during the experience were: My body was dead and I knew nothing of it.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I believed I could experience any location I wanted.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
